Create an exact GPT Image 2 design mockup for existing DooKnow UI. Render one readable complete app-owned window with sufficient host context. Never pretend independent panels are simultaneously open. Captions outside app UI state source ID/title/role/state.

VIEWPORT Readable desktop full window/panel; independent board views each use a1440px desktop host or readable window crop.

FOCUS Canonical shared searchable DirectoryTreeSelect, expanded selected ancestors; retain per-host allowed roots/busy constraints.
Actual ToDoo screenshot is STYLE ONLY (hierarchy, palette, typography, spacing, density); brand DooKnow. Actual platform screenshot is CONTENT/ROLE reference, not target style. Fictional legal examples only; masked secrets and example.invalid URLs.
COMPLETE FIELDS IN SOURCE ORDER:
WS-023 搜索目录 [search; optional]: No additional client constraint found; server validation not otherwise verified.
WS-023 目录选择 [tree-select; required]: Root + supplied folder hierarchy; selecting a string emits new value.
IMPLEMENTED ACTION WHITELIST:
WS-023 选择目录: Change only caller target folder; guard: Owner session; control-specific guards described in permissionRules.
WS-023 展开 / 搜索 / Escape: Browse/filter or close popup; guard: Owner session; control-specific guards described in permissionRules.
PERMISSIONS:
Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.
This row is the canonical shared DirectoryTreeSelect visual. Settings ST-015 references this image instead of duplicating the same widget. Each host supplies its own folders/root label/value/disabled state and retains its own selection/submit permission policy; the shared widget grants no additional directory authority.
ALL IMPORTANT STATES (stateCoverage maps visible/shared-pattern/nonvisual rules; never depict incompatible alternatives together):
WS-023: Expanded ancestors of selection
WS-023: Search expands all folders
WS-023: Disabled while caller busy
SOURCE NOTES:
WS-023: Canonical visual owner WS-023; ST-015 is a host-context reference. Keep per-host valid root choices, existing-directory lists and busy guards distinct.
RESPONSIVE Linked390/320 jobs handle compact field order/drawer/stacking and safe scrolling. 
FORBIDDEN:
Brand is DooKnow; ToDoo is an existing app and style reference only.
No invented fields, actions, role hierarchy, authentication gate, password sharing gate, automatic save guarantee or backend expansion.
No real secrets, share capabilities or private data: use fictional legal example content, example.invalid URLs, masked secret fields.
Never render API protocol metadata requestId/hash/cursor/expectedVersion as editable fields unless the actual source UI has that input.
No native OS/browser picker or print-dialog chrome.
No owner account/tree/file/share-management/upload/generate controls in a public guest or standalone export host.
No developer/source/API path or review-note text inside product UI.
All mockups and per-image/global functional reviews must pass before product development. Do not draw protocol metadata as form controls.
EXACT SOURCE-HOST REALIZATION: Render a readable close crop of the actual Workspace search-sidebar directory selector, not a newly invented dialog. Enough host context consists of DooKnow brand above existing search controls and a small neutral adjacent main-pane edge. Selected visible state is enabled dropdown open, expanded ancestors of current selection, NOT busy. Actual host root label is 所有目录. Field order in the host: search query 知识; 搜索模式 set to 混合检索; 搜索目录 tree-select showing selected path 30-Knowledge / 方法. The ATreeSelect combobox supports optional text search; render its editable/searchable control directly above the anchored tree, no new standalone modal field. Popup root 所有目录 expanded, child 00-Inbox collapsed, child 30-Knowledge expanded, nested 方法 selected with a pale blue row and checkmark; nested 参考资料 and sibling Projects may appear as fictional supplied existing folders. The selected ancestors are expanded. Show chevrons and tree guide lines; popup list height is bounded and can internally scroll. Existing folder names are choices only, never editable management fields. Choose by row click; Escape closes the popup. Do NOT draw confirmation/cancel footer, new-folder/create/delete/rename buttons, upload buttons, directory management menus, permissions, native file picker or any toolbar inside the tree popup. No modal title '选择目录' or additional authority implied. Do not render source paths or implementation metadata. Do not add host New/Delete controls to this close crop. The disabled-busy and active-filter-expands-all states are separate unrendered contracts, not simultaneous visual claims.
FLAT STYLE CONTRACT: Style authority is actual ToDoo screenshot ONLY; source authority is actual DooKnow components. No ToDoo task/goal actions. Solid #ffffff main/header; #f7f8fa sidebar; #272b3a text; #657084 muted; #e6e9f1 borders; #4566c6 primary; #edf1ff selected. Thin crisp line icons, clean sans-serif Chinese, 8px radii, minimal shadow. No gradient, texture, grain, glow, bevel, simulated paper or illustration. Include source ID/title/authenticated owner/selected visible state in a thin external margin, never inside product UI. No browser chrome or device frame. No invented save, AI, sharing or collaboration UI.
